definitions: An act or spell of running.
A continuous spell of something, especially success or good fortune.
A ladder in a stocking or pair of tights.
An enclosed area in which domestic animals can run freely.
A sudden demand for a commodity or service.
A series of performances or screenings of a play or film.
A score in cricket or baseball.
A general or average type or class.
examples: A quick run to the shops.
She had a run in her stocking.
The play had a long run.
